# Coverage reconciliation: the collector against DefiLlama, day by day

*Generated by `scripts/coverage_reconciliation.py`. The collector measures the SOL-quoted family of pump.fun tokens; DefiLlama reports the fees of the whole bonding-curve product. The two are reconciled through the fee rate: curve fees = 1.25 % of swap volume (0.95 % + 0.30 % creator fee). The collector's daily JSON gives the SOL **bought** on the SOL-quoted curve (third-party positions of every entry age plus the creators' own buys); the implied total swap volume from DefiLlama is fees ÷ 1.25 %. The ratio of the two is not expected to be 1 (buys are roughly half of swap volume, the SOL-quoted family is about 60 % of curve swaps, and the SOL price moves within the day); what matters is whether its movements are explained: over the window the ratio fell from about 0.43 to about 0.21 while the SOL-quoted family's share of curve swaps fell from 75 % to 52 % and the mayhem variant grew; the ratio therefore tracks the **family mix**, not lost hours (the coverage record of section 1 of the 16-day report shows the minutes read). This is the reconciliation a reader can run without the raw files.*

Ratio over 16 days: mean 0.342, standard deviation 0.067 (20 % of the mean), min 0.203, max 0.429. The drift of the ratio over the window follows the share of the SOL-quoted family (last column): the mix inside pump.fun moved toward the mayhem variant and other quote tokens in the second week, which is why the paper reports all launch modes (−24 % of crowd positions week on week) next to the SOL-quoted family (−29 %).

Totals over 16 days: SOL-quoted tokens are 59.6 % of curve swap pairs; curve fees reported by DefiLlama $33.5M; SOL bought on the SOL-quoted curve 8,356,988 SOL.
